interpretation: RTEC received bilingual employee-wellness/training material through the current UHC relationship.

timeline_implications: Benefits administration has repeatedly combined enrollment, billing, payroll contribution/reconciliation, employee communication and carrier portal work.
Carrier/provider changes do not erase the underlying recurring control points, but every plan term and provider instruction must be versioned.
Historical benefit summaries are useful for plan-history analysis and document recognition, never for current employee coverage advice.
